summary: The candidate adds test-only hardening around a recovery already present on the recorded base. All candidate tests pass on the base, so the diff is not a failing-before/passing-after fix. Existing eager-path recovery contains demonstrated all-NaN softmax rows, but the original rare CUDA/H100/TP=8 cause remains unverified and broader invalid multinomial inputs remain uncontained.

tests.what_was_measured: Candidate regression suite at exact commit: 3 passed.
The exact candidate tests also pass unchanged on the recorded base: 3 passed, proving there is no failing-before regression in the candidate diff.
Real gfx950 execution through sample_draft_block's eager callback recovered an all-NaN softmax row and sampled token 0.
On gfx950, all-minus-infinity and positive-infinity logit rows recovered to token-0 one-hot probabilities; a valid row matched a float64 CPU reference within 2.20e-08.
NaN outside column 0, positive infinity, negative probability, and zero-sum rows remained unchanged by recovery and each failed torch.multinomial.

An isolated gfx950 process reached HIP multinomial with an unrecovered invalid row and aborted with HSA_STATUS_ERROR_EXCEPTION / CUDA error: unspecified launch failure, reproducing the device-side failure class.

gpu_execution.evidence: AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 with PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015. Safe recovery and actual eager sample_draft_block probes completed; an isolated invalid-input probe produced a device-side process abort.

remaining_counterexamples: A probability row with NaN outside column 0 is not recovered and fails torch.multinomial.
A probability row containing positive infinity is not recovered and fails torch.multinomial.
A probability row containing a negative value is not recovered and fails torch.multinomial.
A zero-sum probability row is not recovered and fails torch.multinomial.
The candidate tests pass on the recorded base, so the candidate supplies no failing-before/passing-after evidence.
The rare source of invalid probabilities in the original DeepSeek-V4 CUDA TP=8 workload remains unidentified.
remaining_limitations: The assigned environment had one AMD gfx950 GPU under ROCm, not eight NVIDIA H100 GPUs under CUDA.
TP=8, full HTTP serving, the fast DSPARK native sampling kernel, week-long production traffic, and semantic accuracy were not reproduced.
Direct malformed probability counterexamples test the multinomial boundary but are not normal outputs of the immediately preceding torch.softmax.
No native source changed in the candidate, so no native rebuild was applicable.
